scene: Inside the rumbling cab, miniature rainclouds leak through the open dashboard vents.
beats: A cheerful electric jingle blares through harmless static sparks just as the truck brakes smoothly inside the buzzing, glowing neon workshop, pop-sliding the cab doors wide.
You scoop the cool puff into your palm where it tickles into sweet lime drizzle, just as the truck halts among giant luminous letters and the doors swing open.
Inside lies a glowing glass tube shaped like an ampersand, which you carefully pocket right as the truck halts inside the glowing workshop and the doors clunk open.
picture: Inside the flat-bench tow truck cab. A burly driver steers on the far left next to a glowing radio dial. The player sits centre in his corduroy jacket and beanie. Up high drifts a tiny raining cloud. On the right bench sits a green toolbox, with rooftop tanks visible through windows.
shown: a crackling dashboard radio with a glowing red dial on the left
a tiny puffy grey stormcloud drifting near the ceiling up high
a dented metal toolbox latched shut on the bench seat at the right

after.beat: You stay put as the truck cruises past Neon Sign Hospital, breezing under a sparkling sky. At the terminal, you hop a whistling mail train straight to the bustling Lost Property Depot.
after.then: Step off at Lost Property Depot

variants.scene: The warm truck cab hums as tiny storm clouds float from the dash.
beats: A lively tune crackles over warm sparks as the truck glides into the bright neon shop, its doors popping wide open.
The misty cloud dissolves in your hand into sweet, cool lime drops just as the truck parks among giant glowing signs and the doors swing.
You find a bright neon ampersand tube and slip it safely into your pocket as the vehicle stops in the glowing garage and the doors click open.
variants.ride_on: You stay inside as the truck bypasses Neon Sign Hospital beneath twinkling skies. At the end line, you catch a whistling mail train to the busy Lost Property Depot.

variants.scene: Little drizzle clouds drift overhead while you think about {quest} on this rainy ride.
beats: A cheerful jingle snaps through gentle static sparks right when the truck stops inside the buzzing, colorful workshop, sliding both cab doors open.
Your fingers cup the soft vapor, which melts into sweet drops of lime drizzle as the truck pulls up beside giant neon letters and opens its doors.
Tucked inside the chest is a glowing ampersand glass tube that you stow away just as the truck brakes in the luminous workshop and doors pop ajar.
variants.ride_on: You ride along past Neon Sign Hospital under clear, sparkling stars. Switching to a cheerful mail train at the depot, you arrive at the bustling Lost Property Depot.

variants.scene: Raindrops tap the windows while fuzzy little clouds float around the metal dashboard.
beats: Bouncy music buzzes through harmless sparks just as the truck eases into the brightly lit neon repair shop, letting the doors swing wide.
The chilly cloud tickles your palm and turns to sweet lime syrup right as the truck halts by oversized radiant letters and the doors push open.
You take a glowing glass ampersand from the chest and pocket it safely as the truck rolls into the shining workshop and the doors unlock open.
variants.ride_on: Remaining aboard, you cruise straight past Neon Sign Hospital into a starry breeze. At the terminus, a whistling mail train whisks you to the bustling Lost Property Depot.
